title: VOOPOO DRAG S2 Pod Kit
description:
The
VOOPOO DRAG S2 Pod Kit
is a compact pod mod featuring a 2500mAh built-in battery and the PnP X atomization platform. Delivers up to 100mL of e-liquid per coil without flavour fading or coil burning.
Product Type:
Box Mod Pod Kit
Battery:
2500mAh (Built-in)
Wattage Range:
5-60W
Charging:
USB Type-C (5V/2A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
5mL
Coil Type:
Replaceable - uses PnP X coils
Coil Resistance:
0.2Ω and 0.3Ω (included)
Airflow:
Adjustable (Top Airflow)
Display:
0.96” TFT Colour Screen
Fill Method:
Side Fill
Power Modes:
Smart / RBA / ECO
Material:
Zinc Alloy + Leather
Coil Compatibility:
All PnP X coils (0.15Ω to 1.0Ω) and PnP-TW coils
Pod Compatibility:
PnP X Cartridge MTL and PnP X Cartridge DTL
Brand:
VOOPOO
⚠ Not compatible with original PnP coils/pods (DRAG S, DRAG X, DRAG H80S) or Argus Pod cartridges. Uses PnP X platform only.
E-liquid sold separately. Compatible with both salt nic and freebase e-liquids depending on coil choice.
Available options: Checkered Black, Sky Blue.
description_html:
The VOOPOO DRAG S2 Pod Kit is a compact pod mod featuring a 2500mAh built-in battery and the PnP X atomization platform. Delivers up to 100mL of e-liquid per coil without flavour fading or coil burning.

  • Product Type: Box Mod Pod Kit
  • Battery: 2500mAh (Built-in)
  • Wattage Range: 5-60W
  • Charging: USB Type-C (5V/2A)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 5mL
  • Coil Type: Replaceable - uses PnP X coils
  • Coil Resistance: 0.2Ω and 0.3Ω (included)
  • Airflow: Adjustable (Top Airflow)
  • Display: 0.96” TFT Colour Screen
  • Fill Method: Side Fill
  • Power Modes: Smart / RBA / ECO
  • Material: Zinc Alloy + Leather
  • Coil Compatibility: All PnP X coils (0.15Ω to 1.0Ω) and PnP-TW coils
  • Pod Compatibility: PnP X Cartridge MTL and PnP X Cartridge DTL
  • Brand: VOOPOO

⚠ Not compatible with original PnP coils/pods (DRAG S, DRAG X, DRAG H80S) or Argus Pod cartridges. Uses PnP X platform only.

E-liquid sold separately. Compatible with both salt nic and freebase e-liquids depending on coil choice.

Available options: Checkered Black, Sky Blue.
